houseStyle.purpose: Canonical item-art consistency note for future repaint and derivative work.
houseStyle.description: Premium hand-painted classic fantasy MMO inventory art with tactile materials, crisp focal edges, softer peripheral brushwork, restrained magical accents, a warm top-left key light, cool deep shadows, and a deep charcoal, umber, navy, or zone-tinted painted vignette with subtle haze and grounded contact shadow.
houseStyle.composition: Opaque borderless square, one centered inventory object, about 68 to 76 percent tile coverage, safe padding on every side, and legibility at 22px, 28px, 40px, and 64px circular crop.
houseStyle.avoid: Text, labels, UI borders, rarity frames, watermarks, checkerboards, transparency, split sheets, collages, mannequins, hand-held presentation, cropped subjects, glossy placeholder rendering, and black-void product shots.
